note.en: The sumo twist-down this judo form borrows its name and shape from.

bannedNote.en: Prohibited in competition: the blocking hand works directly on uke's leg, and the IJF bars any attack on the legs with the hands or arms. The technique is unaffected outside contest.

about.en: The outer knee twist-down, borrowed from sumo's soto-muso: one hand leaves its grip to press the outside of uke's knee, and the other hand and chest twist them down backwards over the blocked leg. A rarity of international contest footage rather than the Kodokan classification, documented here under the name the video libraries use.

en: Break the balance to the rear corner before the hand goes to the knee
The palm blocks the outside of the knee; the block holds still while the body turns
Twist with the remaining grip and your chest, steering them down over the blocked leg

cue.en: One hand drops to press the outside of the knee and the twist takes them down backwards over it.
